parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the suitcase is made of durable plastic, designed for carrying and lifting the suitcase comfortably.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift, carry, and maneuver the suitcase easily.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot slightly or remain fixed depending on the design, but it does not move independently during normal use.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the upper cover of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate for impact resistance and lightweight protection.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the contents of the suitcase and closes securely against the base body, often with hinges and locks.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open and close the suitcase.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body forms the main compartment of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and protects the items stored inside the suitcase, providing structural support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation to which the lid is attached via hinges.
